audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart said Yone on all 7 rows while content win[] and the packet levelChart say Xerath on all 7; the full whys were generic Xerath-favoured templates contradicting their own side token.
audit.why: Packet chart, content layer and the 52.74% win rate agree stage control is Xerath's; Yone is melee with no gap-closer until 6 against 750+ range artillery.
audit.corrected: All 7 phases[N].side moved to Xerath with 6/10 ratings and Yone-specific why rewrites. win[N] already Xerath everywhere — no content pair needed (no-op pairs are rejected).

audit.why: All 4 spikes present: 3-5 poke dominance, 6 (his ult spike vs your longer R), first item burst, late sniping. Accurate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer claimed Xerath's W roots ('W-root shuts down his E all-in', 'leaves him rooted-in-place if you W him mid-dash') — Xerath W only slows; the stun is E. Also breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers, and the W Spirit Cleave shield-absorbs-burst interaction was unstated.
audit.why: Riot's text: W 'slowing and dealing magic damage', E 'stuns them'. Yone W grants a shield on a ~14s base cooldown; E Soul Unbound is 22s rank 1 / 10s maxed.
audit.corrected: W-root claims replaced with E-stun phrasing in whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid; cooldowns rewritten with E 22/10s, W ~14s, own E 13s; shield noted in phases[1].why and cooldowns.

audit.why: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to match their titles with kit-grounded content.

edits.after: Level 1 he is melee with no dash at all — Q his every last-hit from fog range for free. Mana is the only governor.

edits.after: Xerath

edits.before: W joins the pattern: Q-W on the slowed target is the chip combo that defines the next twenty minutes.
edits.after: Q-W on the slowed target is the chip pattern — his 700-range W shield is his only answer, so poke it out first.

edits.after: Xerath

edits.after: E completes the kit: hold the stun for the level-6 all-ins to come — for now he simply cannot reach the artillery.

edits.after: Xerath

edits.after: Xerath

edits.after: Xerath

edits.after: Luden's spike: Q-W chunks third-bars before his marks proc. He farms at half HP or he doesn't.

edits.before: Yone
edits.after: Xerath

edits.before: Late Xerath wins fights from the next postal code: stun the entry, barrage the objective, and never be seen.
edits.after: Late you snipe from ranges his Q3 dash never covers — stun the entry and hold Zhonya's for Fate Sealed.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Check it before every step-up. - E Shocking Orb is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Yone E Soul Unbound: 22s at rank 1, 10s maxed — his burst window; survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. - His W shield cycles about every 14s. - Your E Shocking Orb (13s) is the lifeline; chip never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: Q the last-hit from beyond his answer range, W the lateral dodge, and walk — a one-way trade he can only end by leaving the lane.
edits.after: His Q3 and R both telegraph a straight line — fire Shocking Orb down it while he winds up, and the knockup dies in the wind-up.

edits.before: Spending E on chip and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive on schedule — the stun is your only 'no' and everyone knows it.
edits.after: With Q3 loaded the wave is his runway — the knockup into R Fate Sealed starts at 450 range, so give the minion line a wide berth.

edits.before: At 6 Xerath's R outranges Yone's ult and W-root shuts down his E all-in.
edits.after: At 6 Xerath's R outranges Yone's ult and E stun shuts down his all-in.

edits.before: Yone's spike is his ultimate, not his level 6 wave — but yours (Rite of the Arcane) still outranges everything he has. Hold R as a peel/finisher: if he dashes in with Q3 knockup or ults through your minions, W-root him and burst him with charged R shots before Soul Unbound snaps him back.
edits.after: Yone's spike is his ultimate, not his level 6 wave — but yours (Rite of the Arcane) still outranges everything he has. Hold R as a peel/finisher: if he dashes in with Q3 knockup or ults through your minions, stun him with E, slow with W, and burst charged R shots before Soul Unbound snaps him back.

edits.before: Through 3-6 your kit simply outranges his. He must walk into your W-Q to farm, and you can chunk him each time; his only answer is the E-ghost all-in, which telegraphs hard and leaves him rooted-in-place if you W him mid-dash. Hold your stun for that window and you win every trade.
edits.after: Through 3-6 your kit simply outranges his. He must walk into your W-Q to farm, and you can chunk him each time; his only answer is the E-ghost all-in, which telegraphs hard and marks the body he must snap back to. Hold your E stun for that window and you win every trade.
